data.name: Sachindra
data.gender_notes: Sachindra is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sachindra is recorded with the meaning “Lord of Consciousness”. Sachindra is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of Consciousness”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: सचिन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Lord who is conscious and who makes all conscious

in_hindi.name: सचिन्द्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: सच और जो सभी को चेतन बनाता है

in_marathi.name: Sachindra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Consciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sachindra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words 'Sat' (truth) and 'Indra' (Lord of Consciousness).

in_bengali.name: Sachindra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Consciousness
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sachindra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit words 'Sat' (truth) and 'Indra' (Lord of Consciousness).
